The paper presents an electrical equivalent model of a Dielectric Barrier Discharge (DBD) system using MATLAB Simulink.
DBDs are known to be an efficient technique of plasma generation with respect to energy consumption and device complexity.
The electrical equivalent model can be used to study the temporal development of electrical quantities, such as voltage, current, and charge, in the DBD discharge gap.
The paper discusses the two regions of operation for a DBD circuit: before breakdown (OFF state) and after breakdown (ON state).
